_about: 1-18 (wave 4a, round 1, on the build with R23's tap rules, G9, G1, the stones and WAKE): crate_ent_883 is the weight for button_687, which holds door_lift_671 open
(a lift door stays up only while its switch is held, step 133), and two pillars stand between the spawn and the door: wall04_ent_880 hangs from the ceiling to y 174 (x 372 to 436)
and wall04_ent_881 stands on the floor to y 160 (x 488 to 552), too tall to walk round or over. The player cannot jump, so the level is four portal pairs: the player up onto
the block he stands beside, the crate onto the button, the player past the first block, the player over the standing pillar. Won on tick 422; 8 shots, none failed, medal 2,
no achievement (1-18 has no rule of its own). Leans on: a portal carries the crate (teleportable) and the player alike, the tap-time ray that ends at the first body, and the lift door's latch.

Pair 1, the player onto block00_ent_882 (x 64 to 128, top y 162): a shot to (112, 130) (tap 28, placed on 50; a ray from the spawn at x 157 has to clear the block's top corner (128, 162), so the point is over the block,
and x 104 to 120 holds), then one on the player (tap 57, through on 59): he falls the 14 units onto the block and stands at (112, 144.4).
Pair 2, the crate onto the button: the far portal FIRST, a shot to (288, 100) over the button (tap 86, placed on 137), then the near one, a shot to (40, 160) 6 units over the crate's top
(tap 138, placed on 155): the crate is inside the second portal's 14 units as it opens and goes through on 155. An entry is an edge, so a portal that opens on a body already in it
never carries it; the near portal after the far one is the only order that works (tried the other way round the crate never moved). It comes out of (288, 100),

falls onto the button (the lift's door_opened on 164) and rests on block00_ent_826 from 195, which holds the lift open for the rest of the level. The near portal's y holds from 152 (below that it is out of the crate's reach) and its x from 20 to 60.
Pair 3, the player past the block: a shot from the block top to (343, 50) (tap 167, placed on 239; 250 units, the longest flight), a ray that passes 20 units over the crate, which now fills
x 259 to 317 up to y 104 (a lower point is a ray into it), then one on the player (tap 241, through on 243): he comes out at (343, 50) and falls to the floor between the block and the hanging pillar
(landing on 261, x 343). He walks right from 266 to x 390.6, under the hanging pillar (his head is at y 188 against its 174), and stops there; the camera is within 0.4 of still by tick 298.
Pair 4, over the standing pillar: a shot to (520, 135) (tap 298, placed on 339), a ray that passes 7.3 units under the hanging pillar's right corner (436, 174) and 7.3 over the standing pillar's
left corner (488, 160), and the point holds from x 496 to 532 and from y 119 to 143 (a ray from this spot through that slit); then one on the player (tap 341, through on 343):
he comes out at (520, 135) and falls onto the pillar's top at y 160, walks right from 346 off it, drops into the gap between it and the lift (the two crystals at x 576 on 360 and 362),
walks on under the open door (it has been fully up since tick 204) and into door_ent_484 on tick 422.

Margins: each tap moved alone holds 3 ticks either way (tap 3 two earlier, tap 2 two later), because each waits the 25 ticks the one before it needs; the first walk starts anywhere from 258 to 270 and ends from 280 on, the second starts up to 8 ticks earlier (he walks into the portal) or later. The player is never
outside the camera's view; the only jumps are the three portal traversals.
